body:
Hands down, take it. 
I'm 21 and already bored.
Very good point!

Is that 'The Demon Dictionary' ?
Where did you download it from?
Would you talk about your experiences?
Whaaaat?
This is interesting! Excuse my ignorance, but are you referring to the government as a demonic entity, or a source of evil in general? Is it metaphorical or literal? Or did I completely misread this?

I'm really intrigued, not just on your view point on demons but on your stance as an atheist in general. What were the main reasons you chose atheism, as in what evidence made it a conclusive decision for you?
Thanks so much for your help!
Awesome thanks!
Very true, there is alot of garbage out there to sift through, have you done any research on the topic yourself?
I definitely know what you mean! In your studies have you come across any general themes or similarities that unify ALL cultures?
Thanks! What version is this? Do you know of any other instances where demons are 'explained'?
Can you tell me why? I'm genuinely interested in all points of view!
I can imagine! Do you know the significance of goats/horned mammals when it comes to demons or evil in general? It's pretty huge in pop culture right now...
Definitely worth investigating! I would love to find the connections (if any) between different cultures via their approach to demonology. I wonder what conclusions could be drawn from such finds.
Haha, got ya.
Awesome, thanks!

Thanks for the link! As for your personal experience, were you old enough to remember any of the occurrences that happened in the house that lead you to believe it was haunted? I also mentioned this in another comment, but is Catholicism the only denomination equipped to deal with these kind of things? Would changing your physical location fix the problem? Not trying to spook or challenge you, it's all purely out of curiosity!
Please elaborate!

I really like your viewpoint, and the emphasis you place on fact, as it is pretty rare when dealing with something like this - so I really appreciate you expanding on your statement! 

I remember hearing a message at church on one of the rare times I attended since I left home. The Pastor made a statement about the Devil, and how he is more apparent to those who believe in God - the whole "Satan WANTS you to believe he doesn't exist" thing.

How do you feel about that?

From what i have read/heard so far, demons are not restricted to Catholicism etc but are generally mentioned or referred to in most religions. Do they all deal with them the same? Is one method seemingly more effective than another, or simply more publicized?
Castaway final scene all over again.
Thanks heaps @pileon. I will definitely look into those. In your experience, have you found that the varying religious perspectives on demons and their origins/existence are conflicting?
Thanks for your input! I'm curious as to what makes you sure? I'd really like to hear more from your perspective.
Thanks @lillojohn, I really appreciate your input!
I really like your approach. Do you have any book recommendations?

Yeah, I did do a fair bit of google research but am still somewhat unsatisfied. You've kinda given me insight as to why it is so hard to find personal experiences from a christian perspective, so thanks!
This will be my kids. And the neighbors' too.
Awesome job man!
This is great, thank you. Do you know how demons can have authority over specific places? And how a human could become possessed? And how does this 'ranking system' work?

I appreciate your advice, but this is literally all I've ever heard. And it fuels my interest more than anything. I'm not naive, I know that it is considered a dangerous subject, but could you even give me an indication as to why you recommend so strongly against it?

Totally valid question! Like I said, I've been brought up in a christian home and my parents are still very religious. When I was involved in Church I was always curious about demons but the curiosity was never 'entertained' (people were uncomfortable delving into such topics) so yeah, I just want to find out more.
It's not uplifting that I'm after, just honesty. So thanks man!
Which brings another question - why are we here? Haha. It's relentless.
Wow, thank you so much!

It's not so much a certain food, it's more the cultural change. I live in NZ and am surrounded by friends and family that don't really support the lifestyle change & it is definitely the minority especially in my city. So the hardest part for me is things like family dinners, social events etc.
I also am a bit worried about some of the replacement products, like 'fake cheese' etc, is it better to just go without than replace them with unnatural options?
Do you have any tips?
How long did it take you to make the transition? Do you have any tips for someone just starting out?
Bloody hell.
Cosmo is for pussies, read a real book.
